note: Hero Hist 2/10. CANON_EXPLICIT: the great Hist of Shadowfen, over pools of its own sap. Speaks for a whole region rather than one tribe; Keepers of the Shell, not a tree-minder. Strategically the most important site in its region and the first thing any enemy attacks.

Hero Hist 1/10. CANON_EXPLICIT (hist-placement.md §3): the town-square Hist standing in a pond ringed by ancient pillars, broken arches and a low stone wall. Speaking; survived the Dunmer occupation, the Flu and Umbriel. Tended by a Keeper appointed by the Vicecanons and resented by the surrounding tribes — the city-tree flashpoint in its plainest form.
Hero Hist 6/10. EXTRAPOLATED under hist-placement R1/R6: the Agaceph's own tree, its gloor producing the needle-faced, rainbow-scaled morphology described in the lore.

Register grove of hero rank, but NOT among the ten power slots — reserve. The three interior peoples named in the lore (Agaceph, Paatru, Sarpa) hold the interior's three slots; this fourth grove stands as a swap candidate.
Hero Hist 7/10. EXTRAPOLATED under hist-placement R1/R6: the Paatru's tree, its gloor producing the toad-like morphology described in the lore.
Hero Hist 8/10. EXTRAPOLATED under hist-placement R1/R6: the Sarpa's tree, its gloor producing the winged morphology described in the lore.

Hero Hist 9/10. Sealed xanmeer Hist — alive, walled into its own Hist chamber and alone for millennia. Power slot granted only on release. hist-placement §3 caps living sealed trees at two or three province-wide.

Hero Hist 4/10. EXTRAPOLATED (hist-placement.md §3): a cutting planted in the city gardens among the Ayleid ruins — speaking, but young by Hist standards and of disputed provenance, with a Gloommire tribe claiming it was taken. Transplanting is attested in the sources (the Blackwood Company's smuggled tree) and the quest plan's MR03 assumes it. Gideon is also the western terminus of the rootworm line.
Register grove of hero rank, but NOT among the ten power slots — reserve. Kept as a record and a swap candidate if the owner wants a Murkmire slot instead of one of the ten.

Hero Hist 3/10. CANON_EXPLICIT: Lilmoth possesses its own Hist despite having no native tribe. This is the THIRD tree, grown after 4E 48 from a root fragment of the second. Young and watched: feared and tended anyway (hist-placement.md §4) — the minder's post rotates, a second tender is always present; no faction may claim exclusive access.
Hero Hist 10/10. CANON_EXPLICIT: the Naga-Kur's tree, with BLUE bioluminescent flowers where every other Hist in the province flowers red. Power slot themed on the bog-blight discipline.

Hero Hist 5/10. EXTRAPOLATED (hist-placement.md §3): a small harbour Hist on the landward side of the city, speaking but the least consulted tree in the province — the speaker's post is a harbour-authority sinecure. Archon needs a tree for its Argonian residents' eggs and dead; the city's life does not revolve around it.
